quest.title: Troubles Traveling Through Tributaries
quest.description: Yue Chuan appears to have picked up Little Meng's drifting bottle...

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: The handwriting in this bottled letter seems to belong to a child...

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: Traveler? Judging from your tone, you know the person who wrote this letter, don't you?

response.speaker: Yue Chuan
response.text: Ah, so that's how it is. Quite the thinker too, this kid. Wanting to become mature...

response.speaker: Yue Chuan
response.text: You know what? I think he'd gain a lot from taking a little trip outside to broaden his horizons.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh. Little Meng did say that he'd like to travel outside Liyue Harbor...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But we invited him that time, didn't we? Why didn't he just agree then?

response.speaker: Yue Chuan
response.text: Hahaha, I suppose that's a wee bit of what you might call a boy's "stubbornness."

response.speaker: Yue Chuan
response.text: It's his troubles, and he wants to solve them himself, you know? Can't be relying on others all the time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But he's not going to solve this problem by floating a bottle downstream...

response.speaker: Yue Chuan
response.text: Well, yes. And that's where a reliable adult comes in, no?

response.speaker: Yue Chuan
response.text: Come on, Traveler. Let's write this kid a letter together, shall we?

response.speaker: Yue Chuan
response.text: Let's tell the kid about all the fascinating things waiting for him in the outside world.

response.speaker: Yue Chuan
response.text: That said... Well, it's not like I've been to too many places, so you're in charge of the details, Traveler.

choices.text: Let's write about the towering ruins shrouded in raging winds...

response.speaker: Yue Chuan
response.text: Whoa, whoa there. Slow down, I'm still writing over here...

response.speaker: Yue Chuan
response.text: Hmm... This goes here... and we write that there...

response.speaker: Yue Chuan
response.text: Alright! That's a wrap — wow, we sure wound up writing a lot...

response.speaker: Yue Chuan
response.text: Honestly, just listening to you talk about your travels makes me want to travel myself!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's not bad at all.

response.speaker: Yue Chuan
response.text: Ah, but at my age, there's too much business to attend to. Traveling willy-nilly is just not something I can do.

response.speaker: Yue Chuan
response.text: Well, I've put this letter into the drifting bottle. Send it down the river.

choices.text: Let's mention the archipelago surrounded by thundering storms...
Let's talk about the island that the Electro Archon split in two...
It's a kid from Liyue Harbor...

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: How did it go? Have you sent the bottle off on its way?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Will Little Meng really receive it?

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: Heh. Usually, it would be a difficult thing. Impossible, even.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then what was the point of us doing all that?

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: Haha, relax. I did say that a certain responsible adult would help him.

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: Do you know of a place called Sumeru?

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: I have a few friends who are businessmen. They are currently planning to get into the mushroom market, so they're going there to perform market surveys.

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: But as you know, "market surveys" tend to also leave much time open for leisure.

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: Since that kid called Little Meng wants to travel, I can ask those friends of mine if they can bring another person along.

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: Don't worry about it. I'll handle all the arrangements.

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: I've made another copy of the letter for other purposes. As for the bottle... Let it go on its way, though I doubt anyone will pick it up.

response.speaker: Yue Chuan
response.text: Isn't fulfilling the dreams of children something adults should do? Relax, you can leave this matter to me.

response.speaker: Yue Chuan
response.text: Ah, yes. I should ask those friends of mine to dress a bit better. Scaring people just won't do...

choices.text: Why are you so willing to help Little Meng?

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: Well, I've put this letter into the drifting bottle. Send it down the river.

dialogues.speaker: Check
dialogues.text: Yue Chuan's drifting bottle was only just released, and hasn't floated off very far yet.
